newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares slither down in low turnover market.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares slither down in low turnover market.

text.p: Danish share prices slipped gently down in a thin market on Tuesday despite Wall Street gains and the strong dollar and in defiance of earlier forecasts of a recovery.
"The expected recovery has not materialised yet, the falls are mainly accountable to the low turnover," one dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index had lost 0.57 point to 155.69 at 1130 gmt, having closed 0.44 point lower on Monday.
The KFX June future was 0.15 point up at 155.25 in 20 paper volume only.
